name: Fujikiri Nao
source: The oldest member of the group. He takes care of Meguru and Hibiki and acts like an older sister to them. He is always kind and sincere towards them, but if they manage to upset him, he can be quite frightening and starts speaking in a Kansai dialect. He does cooking, cleaning and other household chores.
